answer_1.quote: data-driven NLG approaches are beginning to be investigated to assist NGO operators in writing CNs.

answer_2.quote: We report both standard metrics (BLEU, BertScore (Zhang et al., 2019)) concerning the lexical and semantic generation performances and a specific Diversity metric (RR) regarding the generation quality. As a second quality metric, we report Novelty (Wang and Wan, 2018)...

answer_4.quote: We administered the generated 2700 HS-CN pairs to three non-expert annotators... we run an experiment with 5 expert operators from an NGO... instructed them to evaluate/modify each pair in terms of 'suitableness' of the CN to the corresponding HS.
answer_4.guideline: For each HS-CN pair, we asked the operators: a) if the CN is a perfect answer, to validate it without any modification, b) if the CN is not perfect, but a good answer can be obtained with some editing, to modify it, c) if the CN is completely irrelevant and/or needs to be completely rewritten to fit the given HS, to discard it.
